title: Tiny, cute maple leaf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g transform="translate(50,50)">
    <!-- stem -->
    <path d="M0,28 Q-1,22 0,18" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M0,28 Q-1,22 0,18" stroke="#A0522D" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- main leaf body -->
    <path d="M0,20 
             L-4,12 L-12,14 L-8,6 L-16,2 L-10,-2 L-14,-10 L-6,-8 L-8,-16 L-2,-12 L0,-20 
             L2,-12 L8,-16 L6,-8 L14,-10 L10,-2 L16,2 L8,6 L12,14 L4,12 Z" 
          fill="#E85D26" stroke="#FF8C42" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- leaf veins -->
    <path d="M0,18 L0,-10" stroke="#C44A1A" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M0,8 L-7,4" stroke="#C44A1A" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M0,8 L7,4" stroke="#C44A1A" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M0,-2 L-6,-6" stroke="#C44A1A" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M0,-2 L6,-6" stroke="#C44A1A" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M0,14 L-5,10" stroke="#C44A1A" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M0,14 L5,10" stroke="#C44A1A" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- cute face -->
    <circle cx="-3.5" cy="-2" r="1.8" fill="#3D1F0A"/>
    <circle cx="3.5" cy="-2" r="1.8" fill="#3D1F0A"/>
    <circle cx="-3" cy="-2.5" r="0.6" fill="#FFE0B2"/>
    <circle cx="4" cy="-2.5" r="0.6" fill="#FFE0B2"/>
    <path d="M-2,2 Q0,4.5 2,2" stroke="#3D1F0A" stroke-width="1.1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- blush -->
    <ellipse cx="-7" cy="1" rx="2.5" ry="1.5" fill="#FFAA80" opacity="0.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="7" cy="1" rx="2.5" ry="1.5" fill="#FFAA80" opacity="0.7"/>
  </g>
</svg>
